text: If ever miss one moon payment, banks say,
Ha ha! Me take cave back. Enjoy sleep under tree.
Me say no. Crud try hard. So me hunt, me gather,
and me deliver food on kangaroo back to lazy caveman.
One day, Big Rock Lender show up and he say,
You dern. Me falter knees, cry into floor, kiss floor, floor dirty.
Me like. Me now own cave. Just in time to grow many wrinkle and die.
Me pass cave to old sun. Sun say.
Cave outdated. Me sell this dump. Get mortgage on tree. Me haunt tree.
